Name: NukaColaPrime's Penguins for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Penguins are the best. That's just a fact. Permissions were open for NukaColaPrime's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17183]Penguin Chicken[/url] so I've rewritten it to turn penguins into their own livestock animal! 

Penguins live in coops and will give you rocks and eggs. And yes, the eggs can be turned into mayo, but...beware.

Enjoy!
